findings: No correctness regression found. Complete primitive input strings key the shared LF digest cache. Non-string projection inputs and owner values keep their existing guards.

Both computation caches have FIFO bounds of 256 entries and 2097152 retained UTF-16 code units per cache; oversized strings are computed but not retained. This is not a promise of 2 MiB total heap usage. Layout caches are per projector and digest cache is per module.

Layout matcher captures immutable cloned current proof token text. Syntax is still gated by JSON.parse; duplicate keys, key order, escapes, and whitespace inside tokens remain distinct. No JSON reserialization is used for equality.

Every admitted call requires target and reader validation and executes the original ordered linked-owner read loop. Each owner value is revalidated; authorization and projection outputs are not cached. Multiple targets cannot contaminate each other.
Proof clone/freeze remains unchanged. Shared string digest reuse across proofs is safe because the calculated digest is proof-independent.
Only the current helper runtime digest changed in the closure manifest. Frozen epochs, historical fixtures and original oracle implementation remain unchanged.

Added tests instrument builtins but restore them in finally, with default sequential execution. They assert warm-cache computation counts, fresh owner checks, foreign-input opacity, entry/length eviction and oversized no-retention.
scope: Three executable changed files at checkpoint 4cd0697a; later documentation is separately reviewed before final publication. No merge approval.
limitations: Local POSIX only; no hosted Full, Windows runner, integration admission, merge or game/device acceptance.
Performance observations are author measurements, not an independent hosted benchmark.
